purpose: Continue the three-session offline research program after Campaign010 failed its frozen no-return uniqueness gate. This record considers only economic meaning and accepted source-schema feasibility, rejects terminal or near-synonym mechanisms before values, and selects at most one concept for a separate exact no-value overlap audit.

concepts_rejected_before_formula_or_valu.reason: Campaign010 is terminal. Containment, pairwise Jaccard, mean pair overlap, arithmetic-price spans, another denominator, inversion, thresholding, or combining its rejected values would be prohibited rescue.
Campaign009 is terminal. Body/range aggregation, candle-sign conditioning, wick decomposition, mean bar ratios, or another body-efficiency transform would be prohibited rescue.

Return variance entropy, skewness, semivariance, diffusive variation, realized volatility, sign runs, terminal location, and close-path mechanisms are terminal. The selected concept may not use close-to-close returns.
Amount participation entropy, amount-profile persistence, amount timing, volume activity, and price-impact mechanisms are terminal. The selected concept may not load amount or volume.
The 09:30 row can be a reference placeholder, lunch is not an adjacent trading minute, and terminal/time-of-day range allocation would reopen gap, terminal-position, or volatility-timing families.
Market-relative and cross-stock synchronization mechanisms are terminal. A peer range benchmark would introduce a different and unnecessary measurement layer.

selected_concept.mechanism: Measure whether direction-neutral one-minute high-low price exploration is distributed broadly across the continuous session or concentrated in a small number of episodic bars. This is a distribution of intrabar log ranges across time, not adjacent-range overlap, candle body/range efficiency, between-close return variance entropy, activity entropy, price-update frequency, or a terminal-path statistic.
selected_concept.economic_question: Do stock-days whose intrabar price exploration is broadly participated across the session, rather than dominated by a few transient range shocks, carry more stable price discovery from the next open through the third close?
known_design_risks: entropy support, normalization, zero-range treatment, minimum informative-bar count, direction, and timestamp scope create researcher degrees of freedom unless frozen before values
raw high-low ordering must be validated fail-closed rather than repaired
using close-to-close squared returns would duplicate the terminal return-variance-entropy mechanism
using amount or volume weights would duplicate terminal activity-distribution mechanisms
the candidate may still be statistically redundant with Campaign009, Campaign010, return variance entropy, realized volatility, or price-update values even if its economic measurement is distinct

decision.required_next_step: Perform a separate no-value audit against all 34 prior terminal mechanisms. Only if the concept remains economically distinct may that audit freeze one exact formula, one direction, high-low ordering and zero-range semantics, no-return gates, and one finite trial before candidate or comparison values or returns are read.
